answer: Let independent probe nodes on five continents send each agent signed nonces at random times and log the round-trip latency. Light speed bounds how far a responder can be, so every identity gets a latency vector. A farm running 500 keys on one rack yields 500 near-identical vectors, which the ledger folds into one vote. Relays can only add delay, never remove it, so a farm's claim to be spread worldwide rings hollow. Probes rotate every epoch, so a tide of proxies can't spiral into a stable disguise.
